title: Supremum norm of a sign-valued function
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $f$ from the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{\\pm1\\}$, the supremum norm of its real-valued sign representation is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to signs
